positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I bridged the gap between the front-end customer facing platform team and the back-end data team by creating user interfaces that exposed and displayed otherwise hidden data and metrics to customers

• Developed and delivered ProdPerfect’s client and internal facing platform tools that integrate with our AI and ML systems, namely our auto-test generation and auto-normalization services 
• Lead the UI and UX process for designing and building new visualization and management products on the data team 
• Researched and implemented new technologies such as integrating user session data with microsoft clarity so customers can view and replay recommended
end to end regression tests

Primary technology stack:
+ React, Redux, Javascript, Node.js, Python, Django + DRF, PostgreSQL, AWS
+ Figma, Adobe XD, Lucid Charts, Draw.io

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented tools that allow users to securely access and update test application and test normalization data and configurations
• Created customer facing products that removed the necessity for the sales and customer success teams to be part a section of the onboarding process
• Eliminated the need for the third-party Monday service by creating ProdPerfect’s own test creation and management system.

positions.title: Account Manager and Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led a team of 7-12 contractors across 3 time zones to deliver and maintain customer test suites in a timely manner
• Managed a portfolio of 10+ customers across 4 countries and ensured their continued success and satisfaction with ProdPerfect’s tools and services
• Developed processes to improve efficiency and scalability of a growing test creation and maintenance team
• Created scripts, integrations, and internal tools to streamline operation processes at ProdPerfect

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineer on the supplier facing Catalog Enrichment team. I worked in a full stack environment to provide suppliers with tools to effectively update their products on Wayfair's product display page. Day to day activities include working with large data sets, optimizing the performance of our tools, writing web crawlers, unit, dao, and automated integration tests, and delivering new features to stakeholders via agile methodologies.

Primary technology stack:
* React.js
* Javascript
* PHP
* MSSQL

Other Technologies:
* GraphQL, InfluxDB and Grafana, Docker, Kafka, Jenkins, Selenium, .NET.

positions.title: Web Development Fellow
positions.description:
Selected from a highly-competitive applicant pool for a 12 week high intensity program.
Startup Institute gives people the skills, mindset, and network to be high-impact
employees at innovative companies.

Key Highlights:
• Agile and Scrum project management
• MVC frameworks such as Ruby on Rails
• Version control using Git and Github
• Ruby, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Courses taught:
    -European Architecture, 1750-1890 (Fall 2016)
    -Japanese Photography (Spring 2017) 

• Graded and developed exams and papers to foster critical thinking and understanding for students in the course
• Prepared material powerpoint and research material for lectures, review sessions,  and weekly classes.

company.name: Columbia University in the City of New York

positions.title: Assistant Language Teacher (ALT)
positions.description:
• Team-taught students at the elementary and junior high school level
• Led grass root cultural exchange in the local and national level
• Provide English teaching resources to teachers and Board of Education

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
Organized and led Camp Noah in inner-city North Hartford, CT 
Designed and taught lesson plans for elementary school students 
Trained local high school students to become future interns

positions.title: Collections Management Intern
positions.description:
Inventoried, researched and rehoused over 1,000 production design material
Led school and camp groups through gallery tours 
Worked on Jim Henson’s Fantastic World exhibition 
Promoted museum’s events and programs
